headline: Central Bank of Iraq Denies Re-Injecting 600 Billion Dinars and Confirms Transfers Are Executed at the Old Rate Without Additional Costs
summary: The Central Bank of Iraq denied reports that it would re-inject 600 billion dinars into banks due to the change in the dollar exchange rate. It said transfers are executed at the old rate without additional costs.
why: The Central Bank of Iraq manages the dinar and bank liquidity, and its exchange-rate and transfer rules affect banks and dollar access.
